<thought>Based on the ESI‑MS peak at m/z 114.06808 (the base peak) and assuming it is the [M+H]⁺ ion, the neutral mass is ≈113.0608 Da. A formula that matches this mass and the observed ~6.7 % M+1 isotopic intensity (consistent with ~6 carbons) is C₆H₉O₂. The calculated [M+H]⁺ exact mass for C₆H₉O₂ is 114.06753 Da, within a few ppm of the measured value, and the isotopic pattern aligns with the data.</thought>
<final_answer>C6H9O2</final_answer>
